clauses.clause: Escape gap on the route for 40 s, pursuers still chase; collapse waves 3 every 9 s; competent run meets ≥ 10 infected on the route (tune), never an empty street. PO: "The entire level is without zombies".
clauses.note: Current-source mortal complete routes match both canonical final hashes. First nine-second collapse windows: low {'0': 3, '1': 0, '2': 0} actual admissions vs 2 per edge; final hash 146891dc; high {'0': 0, '1': 0, '2': 0} actual admissions vs 3 per edge; final hash a8e9c87d. Every-tick pending/admitted-ID conservation proves real admissions. Both tiers retain exact2400-tick escape windows. The scheduled quotas remain queued while existing infected, reserved street ambushes and perimeter demand compete for the shared cap; changing their admission priority requires broader capacity and route validation, so no population/cap/timer/criterion was changed.
